description.value: Sigma Inn & Suites is a 3-star hotel in Hudson's Hope, positioned off Highway 29 in British Columbia's remote northern Peace River region. The property ranges from standard rooms with microwaves and refrigerators to full-kitchen suites, and operates an on-site bar and restaurant serving both Western and Chinese cuisine. A fitness centre and hot tub make it a well-equipped rest stop in an area with limited accommodation options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The URL in OSM resolves to a third-party booking aggregator (sigmainnsuiteshudsonhope.net) whose about-us page explicitly states it is 'not directly affiliated with Sigma Inn & Suites Hudson's Hope'; despite this, it aggregates genuine property-level detail that appears consistent with the OSM record. The front page and policies page confirm free Wi-Fi (OSM internet_access=wlan corroborates), an on-site guest launderette, daily breakfast with takeaway containers, and an on-site bar/restaurant. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, e-bike charging, tools, wash) are mentioned anywhere in the content.
concerns: The OSM website URL (sigmainnsuiteshudsonhope.net) resolves to a third-party booking aggregator that explicitly states it is 'not directly affiliated with Sigma Inn & Suites Hudson's Hope' — this may not be the hotel's own official website; amenity details should be treated as aggregated rather than first-party.
No phone number present in OSM or anywhere in the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel in Hudson's Hope with an active booking presence and confirmed amenities. A valid accommodation option for touring cyclists in a remote northern BC community.
